title: Quintessentially Dense German Pineapple Casserole
description: A sour, dense, and indulgent German dish featuring pineapple chunks, reduced to perfection in a donabe vessel, with a Mediterranean-friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sour cream, brown sugar, and lemon juice.
Add the pineapple chunks to the bowl and stir until they are well coated.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a donabe vessel and dot the top with butter.
Bake the casserole for 35 minutes, or until it is golden brown and set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the casserole warm, garnished with additional pineapple chunks if desired.
